result.summary: Found 1 clear visual/data bug: an invalid delivery price renders as “€NaN delivery” on a restaurant card. The rest of the page appears consistent with normal scrollable mobile UI patterns.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card in the “Fastest near you” carousel shows “€NaN delivery”, indicating a missing/invalid delivery fee value being rendered into the UI.
issues.suggestion: Guard the delivery fee formatting so null/undefined/non-numeric values are not converted with Number/parseFloat without validation; show a fallback such as “Delivery unavailable”, hide the fee, or display the correct fee from the API.
